title: P ≠ NP
claim: There exists no polynomial-time deterministic Turing machine deciding SAT.

title: PARITY ∉ AC⁰
claim: The PARITY function on n bits cannot be computed by a constant-depth, polynomial-size Boolean circuit family.

title: Monotone k-CLIQUE lower bound
claim: Monotone Boolean circuits computing k-CLIQUE on n-vertex graphs require size n^{Ω(k^{1/4})}.

title: Monotone NP-completeness gap
claim: There exist monotone NP-complete problems with monotone circuit complexity superpolynomial in their non-monotone complexity.

title: NEXP ⊄ ACC⁰
claim: There exists a function in NEXP not computable by polynomial-size ACC⁰ circuits.

title: Exponential Resolution lower bound for Tseitin
claim: Tseitin formulas on (d, λ)-expander graphs require Resolution refutations of length 2^Ω(n / d).

title: C-003b cumulative entropy bound (Φ ≥ size)
claim: For every Resolution refutation π of an unsatisfiable CNF F, Φ(π) ≥ size(π) where Φ(π) = Σ_t H(active_clauses_t).
